display_long_description:
VR Mini Golf — the ultimate immersive mini-golf experience for Meta Horizon.

Play tons of handcrafted courses across breathtaking environments: sun-drenched beaches, enchanted forests, volcanic isles, candy lands, twilight fairways, and thrilling snowbound greens. Offering a dazzling variety of colorful balls and skins, day/night cycles, and seasonal weather that change gameplay. 

Advanced, realistic physics and brilliant, vibrant graphics deliver satisfying ball control and authentic putting. Overcome creative obstacles, portals, ramps, windmills, and dynamic hazards that test skill and strategy.

Move naturally with real physical movement or use precise joystick controls; height adjustment and full left/right hand support let you play standing, seated, or even lying in bed — total accessibility and comfort. Intuitive UI and smooth performance make gameplay accessible to both newcomers and pros alike.

Boast to your friends or challenge yourself, complete quests, and rise on leaderboards. We actively update the game with new courses, features, and optimizations.

Download now on Meta Horizon for an accessible, social, and endlessly replayable VR Mini Golf adventure.
